name: Uruguay
description: Uruguay from the Charrúa and the Banda Oriental to independence in 1828, Batlle's welfare state, the first World Cup, dictatorship and Mujica.

checkpoints.name: Banda Oriental
checkpoints.note: Portugal founded Colonia in 1680 and Spain Montevideo in 1724. Artigas led the fight for independence.

checkpoints.name: The republic
checkpoints.note: Uruguay became independent in 1828. Batlle built a welfare state, and Uruguay won the first World Cup in 1930.

checkpoints.name: Dictatorship and democracy
checkpoints.note: The army ruled from 1973 to 1985. Democracy returned, and Mujica was elected in 2009.
